stories.canonical_title: Nepal government websites start returning after PHP flaw outage
stories.known_facts: Reported: Government websites in Nepal that went offline on Thursday because of a PHP security vulnerability are beginning to come back online, Onlinekhabar reports. No full restoration timeline or official confirmation was stated.
stories.latest_development: Reported: Government websites in Nepal that went offline on Thursday because of a PHP security vulnerability are beginning to come back online, Onlinekhabar reports. No full restoration timeline or official confirmation was stated.

stories.canonical_title: Phantom Blade Zero reviews praise fast wuxia combat
stories.known_facts: Reported: Reviews of S-Game's wuxia action game Phantom Blade Zero praise its fast, cinematic combat while noting thinner storytelling elsewhere, according to Polygon, VGC and Eurogamer.
stories.latest_development: Reported: Reviews of S-Game's wuxia action game Phantom Blade Zero praise its fast, cinematic combat while noting thinner storytelling elsewhere, according to Polygon, VGC and Eurogamer.

stories.canonical_title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War releases 50th episode
stories.known_facts: Reported: The 50th episode of Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has aired, concluding the anime's roughly 22-year run, according to Japanese anime press. No plot events or character outcomes are described here.

stories.known_facts: Reported: The Securities Board of Nepal issued its Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Directive, 2083, on Oct 16, requiring investors with transactions of Rs 1 million or more to disclose additional information, Nepalnews reports.

stories.canonical_title: TU Kirtipur campus requires ID cards during Nepal Premier League
stories.known_facts: Reported: Tribhuvan University's University Campus in Kirtipur has asked students, professors and staff to carry identity cards while entering during the Nepal Premier League, which runs from Kartik 9 to Mangsir 5 (26 October to 21 November 2026).

stories.canonical_title: Babarmahal footbridge to open this week
stories.known_facts: Reported: The under-construction footbridge at Babarmahal in Kathmandu is set to come into operation this week to ease pedestrian crossing and reduce road accidents.
